name: Strength and Dignity Nurse Scripture Mug (12 oz)
seoTitle: Christian Nurse Mug with Proverbs 31:25 Verse
metaDescription: A 12 oz scripture mug with Proverbs 31:25 for a nurse whose faith carries her through long shifts. A gentle thank you gift for Nurses Week or a new grad.
summary: A small ceramic mug carrying Proverbs 31:25, made for the nurse who starts her shift with coffee and a quiet word of faith.
whyItWorks: Strength and dignity is a fitting phrase for someone who spends twelve hours holding steady for patients and families on their hardest days. For a nurse who leans on faith, seeing that verse on the counter before a shift can be a small, grounding moment, and it says you notice what the job asks of her without turning the gift into a speech.

The 12 oz size is a practical everyday mug, the kind that gets used at home for the first coffee or the tea after a night shift rather than sitting on a shelf. Because it is budget friendly, it also works well when you want to thank several people at once, such as a preceptor, a unit manager, and the nurse who took extra care of a loved one. Tuck a handwritten note inside, add a bag of good coffee, and it feels complete.
goodToKnow: The 12 oz capacity is on the smaller side, so a nurse who drinks big pours may prefer the 15 oz version.
It is a home or desk mug, so pair it with a travel tumbler if she needs something for the commute.
Check the listing photos to confirm the verse layout and colors match what you have in mind.

faq.q: Is this a good gift for a nurse who is not religious?
faq.a: Probably not. The scripture is the whole point of the design, so it lands best with a nurse who shares that faith.

faq.q: Can it go in the microwave and dishwasher?
faq.a: The product title says it is microwave and dishwasher safe, which suits a nurse who reheats the same cup of coffee three times.
